label: Debited but payment failed
description: Payer's bank or UPI app debited the amount but the gateway transaction failed or stayed pending, so the merchant never received a success callback.

label: Refund not received
description: Refund was initiated on the gateway and an ARN/UTR exists, but the payer says the money never reached the source account, card or wallet.

label: Duplicate or double payment
description: The same fee, bill or recharge was paid twice — usually a retried checkout, a double tap on a payment link, or a late authorisation after a retry.

label: Chargeback and pre-arbitration
description: The issuing bank has raised a chargeback, retrieval request or pre-arbitration against a captured payment and evidence is due before the network deadline.

label: Subscription, e-mandate and UPI AutoPay
description: Recurring debit disputes: mandate not cancelled, pre-debit notification missing, wrong amount charged, or a mandate debited after the plan ended.

label: Recharge or bill payment not fulfilled
description: Payment succeeded on the gateway but the mobile recharge, DTH top-up, FASTag or utility bill was not applied by the operator or biller.

label: Settlement delay or hold
description: Merchant settlement is delayed, short, or held by risk/KYC review, reserve, or a negative-balance recovery on the merchant account.

label: Fees, MDR and TDR dispute
description: Merchant disputes the platform fee, MDR/TDR slab applied, GST on fees, or a fee charged on a refunded or failed transaction.

label: Unauthorised or fraudulent payment
description: Payment made without the account holder's consent: stolen card, account takeover, OTP phishing, or a payer-side social engineering pattern.

label: Support and service quality
description: Complaints about checkout downtime, delayed dispute handling or support experience with no direct loss of funds established yet.
